items.description: Given a completed agent trajectory, should the experience be discarded, stored as an episodic memory, or consolidated into a procedural skill?
[CogSci 2025] Official pytorch implementation of "Towards a Vision-Language Episodic Memory: Large-scale Pretrained Model-Augmented Hippocampal Attractor Dynamics"

A deterministic, tamper-evident safety harness for AI agents. Every decision is hash-chained and replayable, and the agent has episodic memory. Little Nemo solves mazes from vision inside LithoKraft, a voxel test world.
Local-first companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness: persona, episodic memory, mood, and a web room.
🧠 Curated & live-monitored directory of open-source cognitive architectures, episodic memory engines, world models, and embodiment frameworks for Sentient & Autonomous AI (Updated Daily).
Optional add-on for the soul kit, required for CoPIA episodic memory subsystem.

**Aegis-AI** is a lightweight, high-performance, AI-assisted Fuzzing and Adaptive Execution Engine written in Rust. It utilizes Small Language Models (SLMs) via **Ollama** alongside an episodic memory layer to iteratively refine model outputs, evaluate edge cases, and learn from execution failures with minimal iteration cycles.
Episodes: an open format for episodic memory — what happened, from whose standpoint, when and where

Cognitive-structured Multimodal Agent (CMA-Harness): a memory-centric agent for long-horizon multimodal understanding, generation, and editing — externalizing visual history into episodic memory with selective retrieval. Includes the M2CA-Bench benchmark.

Local-first autonomous cognitive runtime and sovereign skill registry for AI agents: bounded context admission, persistent episodic memory, multi-model neural routing, Stark-grade holographic cockpit, and fail-closed cryptographic verification.
Local, inspectable episodic memory for an LLM: extraction, SQLite provenance, semantic retrieval, lifecycle, and a 51-case benchmark.

Arestrix is an AI Agent Operating System that provides a visual environment for building, coordinating, and running autonomous and multi-agent applications. It combines workflow orchestration, episodic memory, real-time observability, and LLM integration, allowing developers to design, test, and deploy intelligent agent ecosystems at scale.

🚀 AI-powered portfolio with proactive visitor engagement — featuring Ozzy, an intelligent assistant with 12 tools, episodic memory, and semantic search. Built with Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript & 814 automated tests.
Game-agnostic cognitive runtime for persistent AI characters, with episodic memory, grounded actions, and resource-aware LLM reasoning.

Research-grade ML web platform implementing Adaptive Episodic Memory Architecture (AEMA) for long-term AI agents—featuring ensemble clustering, 2D/3D PCA & t-SNE visualizations, multi-algorithm benchmarking, and automated PDF reporting.
A portable context and memory layer for AI clients, combining durable knowledge from an LLM Wiki with episodic memory via Graphiti, exposed through MCP for shared cross-model context
PSSA: a non-transformer language model written from scratch in Rust. Recurrent state-space layer, episodic memory, self-modifying weights, CUDA training, and a full terminal dashboard.
TOME: Temporal Opponent Modeling and Outcome-Conditioned Episodic Memory for Adaptive Tactical Agents in Real-Time Strategy Games
State-of-the-art Web Search Chat Agent built with Multi-View Episodic Memory, Governance, zero-key search failover & JWT auth.

A modular Rust-based self-learning episodic memory system for AI agents, featuring hybrid storage with Turso (SQL) and redb (KV), async execution tracking, reward scoring, reflection, and pattern-based skill evolution. Designed for real-world applicability, maintainability, and scalable agent workflows.

OntoGr Agent Memory is an open source Python library that stores what an agent learned, where it learned it, and when it was true. It ingests source material as episodes, extracts entities and facts, resolves duplicate entities, reconciles facts on two time axes, and returns a budgeted context block that is ready for an answering model.
Token-budget-first, local-first memory engine for AI agents (Rust). SQLite for agent memory.
Claude Code-style workflow for Google Antigravity agents: memory, a safety guard, several agents on one project, checks of every edit, autonomy. macOS, Linux, Windows.
A SPOKE-native Rust core and runtime for transactional agent memory, provenance-backed knowledge projection, and auditable cognition.
Local, traceable cross-agent memory for Claude Code, Codex, Hermes and pi. Rust, Apache-2.0.
Checkpointing for agent sessions that snapshots the full working state of files, env, agent memory, and declared database bundles, so any run can resume, fork, or rewind.
Agent memory bridge — local-first, human-approved, file-native memory for Claude Code, Codex, opencode & gemini
Aether: source-grounded ETH/BTC research, agent memory and Jev experiments for team collaboration.
Archive of github.com/ClickHouse/loom for the Agent Memory Atlas (a copy, not a fork, so commit references stay here).
LINA: agents, memory, records and channels. A fork of Hermes Agent.
Pi coding agent "memory mipmaps" extension - persistent multi-resolution memory
Local coordination server for coding agents (memory, registry, routing)
All-in-one open-source toolkit for reliable AI agents: memory, code search, safe execution, and evaluation in one npx install.
a neuroscience-inspired, evidence-governed research architecture and experimental protocol for an agent memory
Public daily work log, PR/MR progress, and read-only projection of unified agent memory.
Stet — Let it stand. A research platform for user-governed agent memory and continuity across AI models.
In-place deduplication for agent memory: scan, adjudicate, soft-delete in one transaction, roll back by batch
A lab comparing agent memory methods on simulated assistant tasks and LongMemEval
Archive of github.com/Morditux/llm-memory for the Agent Memory Atlas (a copy, not a fork, so commit references stay here).
Archive of github.com/peterjohannmedina/heurchain for the Agent Memory Atlas (a copy, not a fork, so commit references stay here).
